commands.cmd: p=$(command -v ccusage) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && ccusage --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" ccusage

t=$(date -u +%Y%m%d); y2=$(date -u -v-2d +%Y%m%d 2>/dev/null || date -u -d '2 days ago' +%Y%m%d); echo "querying this host's real Claude Code logs, UTC window $y2..$t"; ccusage claude daily --json --offline --no-cost --timezone UTC --since "$y2" --until "$t" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
y2, t = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
keys = ('inputTokens', 'outputTokens', 'cacheCreationTokens', 'cacheReadTokens')
rows = d['daily']
per_day_ok = all(sum(r.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == r.get('totalTokens') for r in rows)
grand = d.get('totals', {})
grand_ok = sum(grand.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == grand.get('totalTokens')
models = sorted({m for r in rows for m in r.get('modelsUsed', [])})
has_cost = 'totalCost' in grand or any('totalCost' in r for r in rows)
cons = per_day_ok and grand_ok
print('this host Claude Code logs, UTC window', y2, 'to', t, '(3 calendar days, --since 2 days ago --until today) | rows for', len(rows), 'day(s):', [r['date'] for r in rows], '| models', models, '| row and grand totals internally consistent:', cons, '| any cost field (grand totalCost or per-row totalCost) present:', has_cost, '| token counts withheld')
sys.exit(0 if cons and not has_cost and len(rows) >= 1 else 1)
" "$y2" "$t"
